resources.string: "Sign in at Settings → RetroAchievements to see your achievements."
"Add your own cheats with the + button."
"No cheats in the database for this game."
"Each screen holds 256:192 inside its panel instead of stretching."
"Scales by a whole number, so a DS pixel is always the same size."
"The ROM may be corrupt or in an unsupported format. If it\'s an encrypted ROM, it needs the real Nintendo BIOS (install it in Settings › System tools)."
"SeedlessDS is a Nintendo DS emulator for Android with customizable controls and RetroAchievements support.\n\nCommercial game ROMs and original Nintendo BIOS files are not included."
"Menu › Cheats: enable cheats from the game database or create your own (Action Replay, pairs of 8 hex digits)."

"• Tap ☰ (or the Back button) to open the game menu.\n• Use a physical gamepad or the on-screen buttons. The DS touch screen is the bottom screen: tap it to aim/type.\n• Remap the gamepad in Settings › External controller."

"• Why do some games ask for the real BIOS? — Encrypted ROMs need the ARM7 BIOS dumped from your console. Install it in Settings › System tools.
• How do I change the screen layout? — Settings › Screens › Layout.
• Can I use a physical controller? — Yes, it is detected automatically; remap it in Settings › Physical controller.
• Where are my game saves? — In app storage by default. Change the location in Settings › Saves and states, or export app data from System tools."

"A game library with covers, savestates with thumbnails, controller mapping, customizable screen layouts, cheats, user profiles and RetroAchievements. Higher 3D resolutions, dynamic resolution and external displays are supported."
"Menu › Save/Load state: 10 slots with thumbnail. Slot 10 is the quick save/autosave slot."
"Video, Screens, Virtual gamepad, Audio, System (DS firmware), General and Advanced. Changes are applied instantly."
"Live tracking and submission require Hardcore mode."
"Sign in at Settings → RetroAchievements to see leaderboards."
"Add a folder with .nds ROMs, or open one directly."
"Add this game to the home screen."
"Each profile keeps its own settings and key mappings."
"\"%1$s\" leaves the library. No file is deleted; you can add the folder again later."
"No DS cartridge dumps in the added folders."
"No DSiWARE titles in the added folders."
"No favorites yet. Hold a game, or press Y, to add one."
"No games with achievements yet.\nA game joins this list once you launch it and RetroAchievements identifies it."
"Start a new game from the beginning."
"This removes its settings and key mappings. It can\'t be undone."
"The emulator will close and unsaved progress will be lost."
"Both screens take the size of the smaller panel, so they line up exactly. Fill area is ignored."
"Bottom screen on the device, top screen on the external display."
"Filling needs keep-ratio or integer scale on"
"Let each screen span its panel even where the ratio would leave a border."
"Presets disabled · the layout settings apply as they are"
"The screen settings apply exactly as configured."
"Top screen on the device, bottom screen on the external display."
"Where the space left over goes on each panel."
"A touch button also registers a tap on the DS screen (touch-through)."
"Accessory in the GBA slot (Rumble Pak, etc.)."
"Allows ROMs that exceed the standard cartridge size."
"Asks for confirmation before loading a savestate."
"Asks for confirmation before overwriting a savestate."
"Assign each DS button to your physical controller."
"Avoids skipping frames that would cause visual glitches."
"Blends frames to smooth the flicker of some effects."
"Check the default mapping for known controllers."
"Covers will be downloaded again the next time you browse the library."
"Creates an automatic savestate periodically or on pause."
"Defaults for every game that has no settings of its own."
"Drops the 3D resolution one step when the game falls behind and raises it back when it catches up. Needs an internal resolution above 2x."
"Enlarges the D-pad\'s sensitive area without changing its visual size."
"Enlarges the sensitive area of the face buttons."
"Fetches covers from the libretro thumbnail server, matched by the ROM\'s No-Intro file name. Each cover is downloaded once and then kept on this device."
"Firmware birthday (some games use it). Month and day."
"Forces the game\'s main screen to always be the top one."

"Frames to hold back the built-in screen so it lines up with a TV/monitor that shows the external screen late. 0 = off. The built-in screen shows the frame from N frames ago, so both screens stay fluid. Try 1 and 2 while watching something that crosses both screens."
"Hides the on-screen buttons when a controller (or built-in handheld buttons) is detected. You can still show them from the pause menu."
"How many frames to skip (Manual mode only)."
"How the DS\'s two screens are arranged."
"Identifies the game and tracks your achievements (Casual mode)."
"Ignores the system Back button during the game."
"Keeps the CPU at high frequency (0 = off). Increases battery drain."
"Let this screen span the device\'s width even if the ratio says otherwise."
"Let this screen span the external display\'s width."
"Lets you re-unlock achievements you already have."
"Loads the entire ROM into memory: faster, uses more RAM."
"Locked while a game is running: close the game to change it."
"Margin around the image on the external display."
"Off while Dynamic 3D resolution is on: the two never run together."
"Off while Frameskip is on: the two never run together."
"Overlays your current RetroAchievements Rich Presence text on top of the game (what RA reports as your activity)."
"Plays a sound when you earn an achievement."
"Puts the bottom screen on top and vice versa."
"Removes from the touch pad the buttons you already assigned to your physical controller."
"Removes the black outline the DS draws around polygons."
"Removes the dark background of the FPS counter."
"Renders 3D above native: sharper, but heavier. Applies when you open the next game."
"Saves battery by yielding CPU on the graphics thread."
"Saves the game\'s save (.sav) inside the savestate."
"Saves the .sav without a header, for compatibility with other emulators."
"Scales both screens by a whole number, so a DS pixel is always the same size. Costs some border and gives back an exact picture."
"Scaling, fill area and vertical alignment for both screens."
"Show only one of the DS screens (touch works when it\'s the bottom one)."
"Shows an alert when you earn an achievement."
"Shows an icon when the game is sped up."
"Shows the 3D resolution in use and the configured one, next to the FPS counter."
"Shows the Start and Select buttons on screen."
"Skips frames to keep up to speed. Manual uses the value below; Automatic adjusts it on its own."
"Some settings are hidden: the preset owns them."
"Speed cap when speeding up the game."
"Spreads 3D rasterizing across several cores. Faster in dense scenes."
"The D-pad registers only 4 directions, no diagonals."
"The DS clock uses the device\'s real time."
"The emulator does not support local multiplayer or the DS WiFi connection."
"The fixed date and time the DS clock will use."
"The user\'s name in the DS firmware."
"This discards this game\'s own settings and goes back to the global ones."
"Tracks achievements without sending unlocks to the server."
"Transparency of the buttons. At 0 they\'re invisible but still work."
"Trims the ROM\'s padding to save space."
"Turns on/off with a tap instead of holding."
"Unzips to a temporary file instead of to RAM."
"Uses 16-bit color in 3D: less memory, slightly less accurate."
"Uses a fixed date/time instead of the system\'s."
"Uses the controller\'s L2/R2 triggers as the DS\'s L/R."
"Uses the real microphone for games that require it."
"What to do with a connected external monitor/TV."
"When opening a game, automatically loads the last saved state."
"Where game saves and savestates are kept. Next to the ROM makes them visible to file managers and other emulators; the ones already in the app are copied over the first time they are needed."
"Where the leftover space goes on the device."
"Where the leftover space goes on the external display."
"Where to place the ☰ button that opens the game menu."
"Which DS screen stays on the device and which goes to the external display."
"Which DS screen to send to the external display. If it\'s the bottom one, touch works from that display."
"Writes SeedlessDS.log in your first ROM folder: device, library, screens, game start and errors. Turn it on only when asked for a report; the file rotates at 4 MB."
"Your password is not saved; only an encrypted token is stored."
"This permanently deletes the savestate in this slot. It can\'t be undone."
"The emulator boots with its built-in HLE BIOS. The real BIOS is only needed for encrypted ROMs. Copy nds_bios_arm7.bin (16384), nds_bios_arm9.bin (4096) and nds_firmware.bin (262144)."
"Choose the 3 BIOS files. They are validated by size."
"Copies the emulator\'s data tree to the folder you choose."
"Export your save states, cheats, config and profiles to a folder."
